issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares addGuestStudents(int) as returning void (see UML lines), but the solution implements addGuestStudents(int) returning a boolean. This mismatch in the method return type will confuse students about which signature to implement and can cause test or compilation failures if tests expect the void signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement UML and description to specify that addGuestStudents(int) returns boolean (and document the meaning: true if addition succeeded, false otherwise), or (B) change the solution implementation to match the UML by returning void (and handle invalid input via no-op or exception). Also update the template to include the correct method signature to guide students.
